subject: Hospitality
title: Hotel Room Blocks and Attrition
description: A quick win: understand Hotel Room Blocks and Attrition.

hook.text: Hotel Room Blocks and Attrition: a surprising example shows why better reasoning matters.

buildup.text: Room blocks guarantee hotels revenue and give events discounted rates. The contract balances risk between organizer and property.

discovery.text: Attrition penalties can reach $50,000–200,000 for large events. Under-attendance doesn't just hurt.

twist.text: Attendees increasingly book outside the block using OTAs (Expedia, Booking.com), finding cheaper rates.

climax.text: Smart planners negotiate lower attrition thresholds (70% instead of 80%) and use tracking technology to monitor room pickup live.

punchline.text: Book 500 rooms, fill 399, pay the penalty. Attrition clauses are events' hidden trap.

quiz.question: What is an 'attrition clause' in hotel event contracts?
options: A penalty if fewer than the guaranteed percentage of blocked rooms are filled
